Each lamp provides downward-facing light that is well-suited for both residential and professional settings. The lamps are fitted with an E27 (VP1, VP2, and VP7) and G9 (VP10) socket compatible with standard light bulbs. Each pendant model is designed for disassembly, making it easy for the end customer to access components and enabling repair and servicing.

records.productDescription:
Certified piping systems cover three main families of piping systems for building construction:
- ABN//EVAC ENERGY: A soundproof drainage system consisting of three polypropylene compound layers with mineral reinforcement and a fireproof additive. The pipes and fittings in this family have a reaction to fire classification of B-s1, d= AND HALOGEN FREE.
- ABN//INSTAL CT FASER RD: A piping system designed for hydraulic lines with high pressure and temperature. This family of pipes and fittings are manufactured with three layers of polypropylene PPR CT RP, which have micro-fibers that resist expansion, as well as antimicrobial, oxygen barrier, ultraviolet protection UV, resistant to disinfection and anti-incrustation protections. This family includes ranges for hot and cold water use, fire networks, flexible applications, and more, leading to the derived families: FLEX, FIRE, WELDING ELECPIPE, GREEN family, etc.
- ABN//SAN ECO SLIDE PLUS:  A sewerage piping system consisting of three layers with mineral reinforcement. This system is halogen-free, anti-fouling, anti-seismic, and making it suitable for use in chemical agents and industrial networks.

All pipes and fittings are also designed to be recycled.

Pyrobel/Pyrobelite and Pyrobel-T are AGC Glass Europe brands of Fire-resistant Glass. 

In case of fire, Pyrobel/Pyrobelite and Pyrobel-T laminated fire-resistant glass comprising of clear or extraclear Planibel glass and transparent intumescent interlayers are intended to transform into rigid, opaque and heat-absorbing fire shields.
 
This product is designed to ensure that people and property are protected by keeping out flames and reducing or stopping heat transmission. Pyrobel/Pyrobelite and Pyrobel-T can be assembled into Thermobel (AGC Glass Europe’s certified Insulated glazing brand) and installed in airports, shopping centers, gyms and any establishment open to the public thanks to its safety characteristics. Pyrobel-T is available in bigger dimensions XXL (2m x 4,5 m). Fire-resistant Glass range can be also produced with our Low-Carbon glass. 

For more information please visit : https://agc-pyrobel.com/en-en

records.productDescription:
Lacobel and Matelac painted glass are both made of float glass, the difference being that Lacobel is painted on one side (glossy) while Matelac is painted on one side and acid-etched on the other (matt). AGC also offers a toughened version of its glossy and matt painted glass named Lacobel T and Matelac T.

Available in a variety of colours and special options, Matelux acid-etched glass is designed to balance privacy and letting in light.

Popular in certain markets for its neutral translucent appearance, Lacomat is a clear Planibel float glass which is painted on one side with a satin finish opalescent paint. Some characteristics of this product are neutral and light translucent appearance, high resistance to stains, especially fingertips and high level of light transmission (over 80%).

Mirox 4GREEN+ is AGC's new range of mirrors manufactured with a water-based paint and is also opaque. It can therefore be backlit while retaining a neutral or colored appearance in harmony with interior décor.

The C2C certification applies to the products manufactured in Europe. Similar certified products produced by AGC Glass Asia are excluded from the scope of this certificate.

records.productDescription: HOIZ is a organic insulation material produced at the Baufritz factory in Erkheim, Germany. It is made from wood shavings of spruce, fir, and pine, sourced from nearby regional sawmills as a by-product of softwood processing. The shavings are impregnated with soda for flame protection, fungal decay and pest control. HOIZ wood shaving insulation is used as thermal and sound insulation for roofs, ceilings, and walls. It is suitable as a non-load-bearing cavity insulation in timber construction, but can be used for all kinds of building structures (including steel).

records.productDescription: The Derako grill system consists of solid wooden slats mounted along with aluminium or flexible dowels to form panels. The length of the panel is determined by the structural conditions and ultimately decided by mutual agreement. The grill panels are designed to seamlessly fit into one another with a half-lap dowel joint. In designing a ceiling or wall with the system, there is a great deal of freedom in determining the dimensions of the wooden slats and spacing between them. The grill system is also suitable for curved application. The ceiling created is open in nature. This makes the grill system particularly suited to acoustic spaces.

Dropps offers a line of concentrated laundry detergent pods and laundry additives designed to address a range of household laundry needs. Odor + Stain Biobased Power Laundry Detergent and Free & Clear Biobased Power Laundry Detergent are enzyme detergents designed for everyday loads to address odors and stains. 4-in-1 Plus Oxi Biobased Power Laundry Detergent is a multi-chamber laundry detergent pod that combines detergent, oxygen-based whitening and brightening components, and fabric care ingredients in a single dose. Sensitive Skin Biobased Power Laundry Detergent is an enzyme-free detergent designed for individuals with sensitive skin.
Activewear Biobased Power Laundry Detergent is formulated for washing synthetic and technical fabrics. Oxi Booster Biobased Laundry Whitener & Stain Remover is a laundry additive designed to be used with detergent to support whitening, brightening, and stain removal.

Laminated glass is produced when two or more glass lites are permanently bonded with one or more plastic interlayers (PVB) using heat and pressure. The glass and interlayers can be a variety of colors and thicknesses. Guardian LamiGlass® can be used in many applications including curtain walls, facades, windows, overhead glazing, partitions, balustrades, floors, doors, furniture, aquariums, art galleries and museums.

Guardian LamiGlass® Acoustic is Guardian’s laminated glass with an advanced interlayer designed to improve performance in sound reduction. Guardian LamiGlass® Acoustic can be used in applications ranging from residential housing to public buildings such as airports, hospitals, hotels and educational facilities -- anywhere noise can affect occupant's comfort.

records.productDescription:
HONEXT® is a new material made by upcycling cellulosic waste fibers into recyclable and non-toxic fiberboards through a circular process. HONEXT® board is designed to have no added volatile organic compounds (VOC) emissions, be fire retardant euroclass C s1d0 or B s1d0, moisture resistant, light, and provide excellent sound and thermal insulation.
It can be cut, drilled, routed, laminated and coated using standard equipment and traditional wood and fiberboards processings. HONEXT® is intended for the interior environment. Potential applications can range from interior wall
cladding finishes and partitions to suspended ceilings and acoustic panels, among others. Standard board and flame retardant board are included.

records.productDescription: LOCTITE HB S (ECO) PURBOND line is a range of moisture curing 1-component liquid polyurethane (PUR) adhesives used for load-bearing engineered wood applications. When applied onto wood, the adhesive cures with air humidity and moisture in the wood to form a strong, wood toned, non-brittle film. LOCTITE HB S (ECO) PURBOND products are resistant to weak alkalis, acids and solvents; they are free from formaldehydes, solvents, fibers and abrasive fillers, and they exhibit good flow properties. LOCTITE HB S (ECO) PURBOND products are single-component adhesives and are processed in a closed system directly from the container in which they are supplied. The adhesive needs to be processed in an appropriate application system. This is an industrial product for professional use only. The adhesive can be used for the manufacture of glued laminated timber, structural finger jointed solid timber, and cross laminated timber (CLT).

records.productDescription: Rødvig Juramørtel (Jurassic Mortar) is a range of lime mortars. The mortars are designed to have great compressive and tensile strength and to be suitable for plastering, pointing, and brickwork. They are designed to be elastic and pliable even in hardened condition, making it easier to avoid cracks in the adherence zone and in the plastering. This flexibility reduces the need for expansion joints in the brickwork. The capillary suction created by lime mortar transports moisture out of the masonry, where it can evaporate from its surface, improving heat insulation and the humidity conditions of the masonry.

records.productDescription: Maars specializes in designing and manufacturing flexible modular glass wall solutions that offer numerous combinations of elements to create bespoke products. For instance, within a single partitioning system, one wall might feature glazed panels, another wood paneling, and yet another steel cladding. Despite their custom nature, all Maars products share a foundational base structure consisting of wall types (steel or glazed), doors, various joint configurations (horizontal and vertical), and customizable finishes such as treatments, colors, and glazing options. The products are designed as a modular demountable wall system to improve the use of resources and materials across the life cycle.

records.productDescription: Acoustical ceiling and wall products manufactured with stone wool. Rockfon ceiling solutions address noise, the risk of smoke & fire, mold & mildew and have a 30 year warranty. Stone wool is designed to be recycled. The ceiling products are available in multiple variants, with different edges, thicknesses, dimensions, colors, shapes and functions.

Acoustic ceiling and wall products made from stone wool. They are designed to be resistant to mold, fire, dust, bacteria, and recyclable. These products are designed to improve acoustics. The products are available in different forms, with different edges, thicknesses, dimensions, colors, shapes, and functions.

records.productDescription: CEWOOD Acoustic Panels are cement-bonded wood wool panels. The wood wool originates from spruce harvested from Latvian forests. records.productDescription: The certificate covers float glass and laminated glass. Float glass is made from raw materials such as silica sand, soda ash, dolomite, feldspar, limestone, and cullet. It is produced using the float process, where molten glass is poured onto molten tin to create a smooth, flat surface. Float glass can be used as-is or used in these processes (coating, laminating, mirroring). Laminated glass is made by bonding two or more sheets of float glass with a polyvinyl butyral (PVB) interlayer under heat and pressure, resulting in enhanced safety and durability.

records.productDescription:
The Strähle System 2000 is a partition wall system based on a steel mullion skeleton, designed for easy disassembly and flexibility. The partition elements are designed for easy installation and change. Products can be composed of solid, double-glazed wall elements and/or sound-insulated aluminum frame glass doors or solid doors. The double-layer construction is designed to ensure sound insulation of the wall system.
The Strähle System 3400 is a transparent partition wall system with single glazing and without vertical posts. The construction consists of floor and ceiling-mounted profiles that support glazing elements. The system can incorporate a variety of door types. The elements are all designed, produced and installed to the specific requirements of the individual project.

records.productDescription:
TEKNOFLOR™ Bio-Polyurethane Flooring includes TEKNOFLOR™ Naturescapes HPD™ and TEKNOFLOR™ Nature’s Tile & Plank HPD™.

Naturescapes HPD is a luxury organic sheet good made from organically-derived polyurethane processed from castor seed oil and natural minerals. This resilient sheet flooring product is designed to be durable, easy to maintain, and versatile. The product offers twenty-four beautiful designs in three distinct styles that can be used independently or together. 

Nature’s Tile & Plank HPD bio-polyurethane flooring products collection boasts 16 visuals, which coordinate with Naturescapes HPD PVC-free sheet in both aesthetic and construction. Designed to mimic every detail, the 500 x 1000 mm tiles are built with the same 2.5 mm thickness of Naturescapes HPD, which means they can be used together without the need for transition strips. Nature’s Tile & Plank holds true to TEKNOFLOR’s no wax, no buff principle and its promise of high performance design - all without the use of vinyl or other red-list ingredients.

records.productDescription: Unilin’s Medium/High/Compact-Density Fiberboards (MDF/HDF/CDF) are designed to have a range of properties (moisture resistant, fire retardant, NAF, etc.) and colors (black, grey, etc.). MDF/CDF is used in furniture, cabinetry, while HDF is typically used in flooring. Pressing an impregnated paper on these fiberboards renders the melamine-faced panel, which is available in different designs (including wood finishes, unicolors, etc.). These are used in residential interior furniture and decorative design in commercial projects. Unilin’s Clicwall products are wall paneling and partitioning walls, which are obtained by applying the Uniclic profile into the decorative fiberboard.

records: Cradle to Cradle Certified Full Scope

records.productDescription: Unilin Panels' High-Pressure Laminate (HPL) is designed to be durable by pressing layers of kraft paper with resin under high pressure and temperature. With over 200 designs available, HPL offers extensive choices while meeting various functional needs. The range includes standard HPL, HPL FR (Fire Retardant), HPL CC (Coloured in Core), and HPL RAF (Raised Access Floor).

records: Cradle to Cradle Certified Full Scope

records.productDescription: A melamine-faced panel is a decorative panel made from a raw board pressed with impregnated paper, both on the upper and downside of the panel. The texture is pressed into the melamine surface under high pressure and temperature using a special press plate technology. The raw chipboard comes in varying properties (e.g. designed to be moisture resistant, fire retardant). In the Unilin Decorative range, over 200 designs are available in melamine faced boards (woods, plain colors, and other materials). Melamine faced chipboards are commonly used for interior furniture and decorative design in residential and commercial projects including retail, office, and hotel sectors.

Indoor Climate Label A+

records.productDescription: Dual Mass Flywheel for commercial vehicles.
Hydrodynamic torque converters used in modern passenger cars with automatic transmissions – both stepped and continuous.

The ZF pneumatic release cylinder ConAct® is designed for push-type diaphragm spring clutches in heavy- and medium duty commercial vehicles. In automated transmissions, the AMT system is designed to automatically determines the ideal release position. Controlled by the vehicle‘s electronics, the solenoid valve regulates the clutch actuation by means of the pneumatic ConAct® cylinder in order to prevent clutch overload caused by the driver.
The clutch cover is screwed to the flywheel and, when engaged, transmits the engine torque to the clutch disc via the housing, the tangential leaf springs and the pressure plate.
